source.connectome: FlyWire FAFB v783 (Dorkenwald et al. 2024, Nature; Schlegel et al. 2024, Nature), CC-BY 4.0
source.connectivity: Connectivity_783.parquet from Shiu et al. 2024, Nature (github.com/philshiu/Drosophila_brain_model)

channels.label: Sugar taste (GRNs)
channels.why: Sugar gustatory neurons drive feeding; in the whole-brain LIF model of Shiu et al. they activate the proboscis motor neuron MN9. Free land is food.

channels.label: Head bristles (touch)
channels.game: Enemy troops attacking us, relative to our own
channels.why: Bristle mechanoreceptors on the head report being touched; an attack is something pushing into the body.

channels.label: Looming (LC4, LPLC2)
channels.game: An attack big enough to break us
channels.why: LC4 and LPLC2 visual projection neurons detect approaching objects and feed the giant-fiber escape pathway (DNp01).

channels.label: Small-object pursuit (LC10)
channels.game: The weakest bordering enemy is beatable
channels.why: LC10 neurons track small moving objects; males use them to chase a courtship target.

channels.label: Visual objects (LPLC4, LC11)
channels.game: Weak bot tribes on our border
channels.why: LPLC4 and LC11 respond to small or approaching objects in the visual field.

channels.label: Collision (LPLC1, LC22)
channels.game: The strongest bordering rival, relative to us
channels.why: LPLC1 mediates collision avoidance; a large neighbour is something to steer clear of.

channels.label: Wind (Johnston's organ C/E)
channels.game: Coastline and targets reachable by boat
channels.why: JO-C and JO-E neurons in the antenna sense wind and gravity; boats need wind.

channels.label: Hearing (Johnston's organ A/B)
channels.why: JO-A and JO-B neurons hear courtship song; another player asking for an alliance is courting us.

channels.label: Ocelli (light level)
channels.game: Game clock: how far the match has progressed
channels.why: The three ocelli measure overall light; the day moves on as the match does.

channels.label: Ascending: energy
channels.game: Troops relative to our troop cap
channels.why: Ascending neurons carry the body's state up from the ventral nerve cord.

channels.label: Ascending: gut
channels.game: Gold relative to what a city costs
channels.why: Ascending neurons into the gnathal ganglia relay feeding-related state.

channels.label: Ascending: body size
channels.game: Our share of the map's land
channels.why: Ascending neurons with multi-neuropil targets; a proxy for how big the body has grown.

channels.label: Ascending: effort
channels.game: Share of our troops already out attacking
channels.why: Ascending neurons to the posterior slope, where locomotor effort signals arrive.
